resolution_refinements.resolve_jurisdiction: Require actor, subject, establishment/market location, conduct, data flow, physical deployment and dispute forum before attaching jurisdiction. GDPR territorial reach is evaluated by Article 3 conditions rather than repo language or global publication alone.
resolution_refinements.resolve_authority_hierarchy: Treat constitutions/laws/treaties/regulations, private licenses/contracts, technical standards/guidance and scientific literature as distinct authority classes. A private document cannot self-promote to supraconstitutional or jus-cogens status.
resolution_refinements.semantic_contextualize: Separate symbolic/spiritual language from technical, biomedical and legal propositions. Terms such as universal, sacred, quantum, living, neural signature and protection require domain-specific interpretation before any normative effect is assigned.
resolution_refinements.cross_cultural_semantic_diff: Preserve multilingual text as authored expression but do not infer legal equivalence across translations. LEGAL_EQUIVALENT remains TOKEN_VAZIO unless jurisdiction-specific review establishes it.
resolution_refinements.detect_normative_conflict: Create conflicts when README evidence gates contradict license assertions, or when a private license asserts automatic global sanctions, universal jurisdiction, ICJ access, public-law crimes, or mandatory effect unsupported by external authority.
resolution_refinements.protected_subject_gate: Any actual human health, implant, neural, mental-health or child-facing deployment activates enhanced safety/privacy review; repository wording alone does not establish that protected subjects were actually involved.
resolution_refinements.evidence_and_conformance_gate: Requirement -> control -> test -> evidence -> scoped status. Publication, DOI, hash, README, license or CI alone does not prove legal compliance, medical-device approval or scientific validity.
resolution_refinements.temporal_validity: External normative sources are pinned to retrieved/current official versions where possible; repo statements without effective date remain temporally bounded to the observed commit/ref.
resolution_refinements.provenance_chain: Every conclusion must retain repo/ref/path plus external official authority; unknown license or runtime remains TOKEN_VAZIO rather than inferred from adjacent repositories.
